title: Analyse
description: Server analytics plugin to track player behavior and acquisition sources.
body:
# **ServerStats - Server Analytics Plugin**

A lightweight, high-performance analytics plugin designed for Minecraft server owners who want to understand their community and make data-driven decisions. Supports Paper, BungeeCord, and Velocity.

## **Getting Started**
To use this plugin, you'll need a free account on [serverstats.com](https://serverstats.com). Sign up to get your API key and access the analytics dashboard.

## **Supported Platforms**
- **Paper** (1.8 - 1.21+)
- **BungeeCord**
- **Velocity**

## **Player Analytics**
Track every player that joins your server with detailed insights into their behavior. See join patterns, session durations, and player retention metrics. Understand when your server is most active and identify your most engaged players.

## **Acquisition Tracking**
Discover exactly where your players are coming from. Whether it's from a YouTube video, Discord invite, Reddit post, server list, or paid advertisement—ServerStats tracks the source of every new player so you know which channels drive the most growth.

## **Marketing Attribution & ROI**
Measure the effectiveness of your marketing efforts with precision. Track influencer partnerships, promotional campaigns, and community events. Calculate your return on investment and double down on what works.

## **Real-Time Dashboard**
Access all your analytics through a clean, intuitive web dashboard at [serverstats.com](https://serverstats.com). Monitor live player counts, view historical trends, and export reports. All your data in one place, accessible from anywhere.

## **Performance Insights**
Keep your server running smoothly with performance monitoring. Track server health metrics without any impact on gameplay performance.

## **Network Support**
Running a network? No problem. ServerStats works seamlessly with BungeeCord and Velocity proxies. Track players across your entire network and see which servers they spend the most time on.

## **Easy Installation**
Getting started takes less than a minute:

1. Sign up at [serverstats.com](https://serverstats.com) and create a project  
2. Download the plugin for your platform (Paper, BungeeCord, or Velocity)  
3. Drop it into your `/plugins` folder  
4. Add your API key to the config  
5. Restart your server  

Zero dependencies. Zero performance impact. Just insights.

## **Privacy Focused**
We only collect the data you need to grow your server. No invasive tracking, no selling data to third parties. Your community's privacy matters.

## **Support**
Need help? Join our Discord community at [discord.gg/serverstats](https://discord.gg/serverstats) or reach out through BuiltByBit. We're here to help you get the most out of ServerStats.

---

Built by server owners, for server owners. Start understanding your Minecraft community today at [serverstats.com](https://serverstats.com).
